pairs.evidence: lib/agent/envelope.ts:34 Reviewer engines act as judges inside the article critique loop, yet the parsed envelope keeps only final, errors, turns and costUsd and never the model the call resolved to, so a verdict is stamped with the requested slug (lib/articles/critique.ts rv.model) and not with the instrument that actually scored it.

techniques.evidence: lib/agent/envelope.ts:34 The standard says a pin is verified by what it resolved to, stamped on the run artifact. The envelope drops the resolved model identifier, leaving only the requested slug.
lib/agent/reviewerEngines.ts:22 The reviewer reads the work product itself (the post, its sources and the experiment files), not the writer's account of it.
lib/agent/reviewerEngines.ts:16 The judge returns its verdict as structured output, and nothing it writes to disk is read back, so measuring cannot contaminate what is measured.
lib/agent/cliSeam.ts:45 Unavailable and seat-limit runs are classified as runs that did not happen, kept apart from completed or errored work. This separates harness failures from arm failures.
lib/agent/cliSeam.ts:65 The candidate writer runs in an isolated workspace (checked by assertIsolatedWorkspace) that cannot hold the reviewer's REVIEW.md rubric.
